description: Crack hashes and handshakes captured during an engagement — identify the format, pick the right hashcat/john mode, and run wordlist + rules. Load when you've recovered a hash, ticket, or handshake and need the plaintext. Signals: bcrypt $2b$/PBKDF2/sha512crypt $6$, NTLM/NetNTLMv2, Kerberos $krb5tgs$/$krb5asrep$, WPA2 .22000, a leaked DB hash column, "what hashcat mode".
